# Architecture Discovery

1. Capture goals, users, workflows, constraints, assumptions, and measurable non-functional requirements.
2. Map domain boundaries, context/container/component responsibilities, trust boundaries, and major data/request flows.
3. Compare viable stack and infrastructure options against explicit criteria; verify current maintenance and security status online.
4. Define API/event/data contracts, deployment topology, observability, failure modes, and migration strategy.
5. Record material choices as ADRs with alternatives, consequences, and revisit triggers.
6. Break delivery into thin vertical slices with acceptance and verification gates.

Do not implement production code or lock a technology solely by preference.
